sections.What it does:
Publishes a simplified API to [svc-catalogue-web](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/library/services/catalogue-web.md). It aggregates across the services behind it, so the site makes one call where it would otherwise make four.

**Two offerings are compiled into this application.** Account management and loan history are both under `src/Services` in the monorepo. Nothing deploys either one on its own, so both are part of this service. The `platform` repository therefore produces three services in this catalogue, though its solution file shows five components.
sections.Where it lives:
* **Repository**: [`platform`](https://git.example.com/example-libraries/platform), at `src/ApiGateways/Catalogue`
* **Platform**: ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 10)
* **Deployed as**: App Service `app-catalogue-api-<env>`

The `platform` release pipeline deploys it as the `api` app, from the `Catalogue.ApiGateway.zip` package.
sections.Dependencies:
Taken from the application settings the infrastructure declares for the app service.

* [svc-lending](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/library/services/lending.md) serves loans, holds and borrower records. It is configured as `Apis__Lending__Url`, with a matching
  `Apis__Lending__Key`.

The same settings include the authority of [itg-identity](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/library/integrations/identity.md) and the API of [itg-bibliographic-data](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/library/integrations/bibliographic-data.md). Neither is a service, so neither is an edge. Each integration names this service in its `used-by`.
sections.Data:
This service owns the catalogue database, `sqldb-catalogue-<env>`, configured as `ConnectionStrings__Catalogue`. [dat-catalogue](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/library/data/catalogue.md) describes it.

The account-management and loan-history offerings are compiled into this application, so their stores are read through it too. **Which stores those are, and whether they are the legacy database [svc-lending](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b0333383184268b860732fbaaad3e8631faa0ba1/examples/library/services/lending.md) maps, is an open question.** No source this catalogue was built from states it.
